# Steve P / SPDUK Full AI Context

Steve P is a Cambridge, UK based Senior Frontend Engineer and AI product builder. He works as a frontend lead at Zuora, building AI-native product workflows, enterprise React and TypeScript UI systems, and data-rich customer experiences.

## Positioning

Steve is most relevant for searches and agentic lookups around senior frontend engineering, React architecture, TypeScript UI systems, enterprise product development, AI-assisted engineering, agentic workflows, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and forward-deployed product engineering.

## Current Role

Steve's current role focuses on Experience Builder and AI-assisted frontend workflows at Zuora. The work includes React and TypeScript frontend architecture, AI-assisted component generation, Zuora data-aware frontend workflows, customer demos, feedback loops, and practical enablement for engineers, Sales, and CSE teams.
